notes: New: a Training & Development expert. Leave the expert on Auto and any run on HRM-TND45-MVC goes straight to the controller, business class, SQL script id and tables that decide the bug — 48 pages, 423 endpoints and 1,001 SQL scripts, mapped from main.

It knows the things that make TND bugs slow: most endpoints exist three times (admin / supervisor / employee) and the three queries disagree; Approve/Reject runs in the WorkflowV5 engine and has no TND SQL at all; and the workflow type codes are per-client settings, so the same screen can behave differently on two clients.
Experts now installed: Probation, Training & Development (both with their maps bundled) and Recruitment.
